mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns, as elevated rates increase the cost of capital and reduce the present value of future equity earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightening, indicated by UNRATE exceeding 5.0%, signals reduced unemployment and stronger economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as the Federal Reserve may accelerate monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as economic growth slows and corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0, indicating a slowdown in manufacturing and supply chain activity, predicts negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns during a supply-constrained economic slowdown regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation, indicated by CPIAUCSL above 210.0, signals potential monetary policy tightening and real interest rate increases, which typically lead to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as markets react to inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns, as stronger manufacturing activity signals robust economic growth and improved corporate earnings prospects.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above 112.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market expansion, indicated by HOUST exceeding 1000.0 (thousands of units), predicts positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as stronger residential construction activity boosts consumer confidence and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) above 380,000.0 (millions of dollars) indicates robust consumer spending, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as corporate revenue growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is above 380,000.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
